_note: Music follows the story. 'style': pad (held chords, calm, for serious or reflective films) or a / b / c (major key with a soft beat: a = light 100 bpm, b = more drive 112 bpm, c = calm marimba 92 bpm). 'sections': from which scene a mood starts. Pad moods: calm, grey, tense, thin, bright. Beat styles use only 'thin' (no beat, quieter) versus any other mood (full beat). The last seconds always end on one resolved chord. 'pulse' adds a low growing pulse (tension) between two scenes; 'shimmer' adds soft high notes. Scene ids or 'end'.
